scope: Isolated local engineering baseline, no scientific quality claim

quality.requires: Independent human-reviewed Chinese, English and mixed query/source relevance labels with source hashes, reviewer identity and frozen split
quality.rule: Compare query strategies on the same corpus before evaluating another engine; generated vectors do not count as semantic relevance labels

cache.connectionCold: Fresh SQLite connection; OS cache remains uncontrolled
cache.repeatedConnection: Same connection after one unmeasured query; do not claim the complete database is resident

decision.rule: A target miss triggers candidate filtering and two-stage ranking investigation first; this baseline does not authorize an ANN or database migration
